title: 5 Hour Romantic Hawaii Jeep Tour
includes: Professional Guide & Photographer (Your iPhone or the Guides, your choice)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
•A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
Weight Restrictions of 225-250 Pounds per passenger
Age Limit up to 70 years of age
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This 5 HOUR ROMANTIC HAWAII TOUR is great for honeymooners, anniversaries or when wanting to Pop the Question etc – We’ll greet you with Flower Lei’s and start our day exploring the most beautiful and romantic hidden gems of Oahu with a COOLER of drinks Pineapple cut fruit, macadamia nuts, local chocolates. On this Tour your guide will bring you to locations where just the two of you will be able to relax and be alone. Your Professional Guide will also take photographs to capture all the special moments with either your iPhone or your Guides, your choice. 

Some of the more off the beaten path locations your guide MAY take you to: Kahala Beach, Spitting Caves, Halona Cove, Alan Davis Lagoon, Makai Pier, fish ponds, then we'll get lunch to go so we can bring it to a Secret Beach so the couple can be alone with amazing Beach and Mountain views...On the way back to the resort we'll take a short walk to a waterfall in the mountains (if in winter and the waterfall is flowing)
